SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SALES A WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND A.SALES_TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')

SELECT A.SALES_ID AS salesId , A.CUST_ID AS custId , A.EMP_ID AS salesUserId , A.SALES_TITLE AS salesTitle , A.EXPECTED_AMT AS expectedAmt , DATE_FORMAT(A.EXPECTED_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS expectedDt , A.PROBABILITY AS probability , A.STATUS AS status , A.SALES_CONTENT AS salesContent , A.ATCH_FILE_ID AS atchFileId , B.CUST_NM AS custNm , B.CEO_NM AS ceoNm , C.EMP_NM AS salesNm FROM TB_SALES A LEFT JOIN TB_CUSTOMER B ON A.CUST_ID = B.CUST_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMP C ON A.EMP_ID = C.EMP_ID WHERE A.SALES_ID = #{salesId} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'
